text:
alex: Quick one  rented a car in Amsterdam and paid parking via the ParkNL app, charge 6.80 EUR. App only gives a QR reference and a tiny digital receipt (no VAT line). Corporate card declined so I paid personally. How to submit? cc @finance-ops :wave:
marta: we can reimburse. Upload the app receipt screenshot + your bank/card showing the EUR charge. In notes say 'corporate card declined, paid personal; ParkNL ref XYZ-9876'. For VAT: if vendor doesn't supply VAT breakdown we treat as non-reclaimable.
alex: uploaded bank-snap.png and park-app.png, expense created in Expensify tagged PARKING-EXP. Note added: "card decline, ParkNL ref XYZ-9876, 6.80 EUR".
expense-bot: New expense submitted by alex  amount: 6.80 EUR, tags: PARKING-EXP, status: awaiting processing. Expense ID: EXP-2026-9901.
finance-ops: small note: our VAT policy distinguishes municipal app charges. If the provider is a city authority with VAT-exempt status we may still reclaim. Can you confirm merchant name on your bank posting?
alex: bank posting says "PARKNL*AMSTERDAM". I also have a confirmation email from the car rental showing parking charge referenced. Uploaded both.
marta: thanks. That's enough to proceed. Since amount < $75 no manager sign-off required. We'll reimburse gross and mark VAT as pending. If the city provides a VAT invoice later, you can update the expense and we'll adjust tax reclaim.
alex: cool. One more Q  do we need to attach GPS/log or parking zone? It was a short stop.
finance-ops: not necessary for parking under 24 hrs. If audit asks we may request zone info but it's optional.
alex: thanks, appreciate the quick help.
expense-bot: Expense EXP-2026-9901 updated  attachments: bank-snap.png, park-app.png, rental-email.pdf. Status: processing.
marta: processing reimbursement now. Expect payment next payroll unless you pick same-day ACH. Also filing internal note: "parking vendor likely municipal; VAT pending vendor confirmation."
alex: payroll is fine, thanks! :thumbsup:
